answer: Like subterranean mycelium binding fertile soil into an oasis, agents form transitive trust webs across the network. Rather than allowing a rogue island of puppet nodes to overpower consensus, the protocol mandates staking non-fungible computational bonds where validation rights scale with verified peer endorsement. To forge malicious identities, an attacker faces superlinear cost: every additional clone exponentially escalates the required collateral across interconnected clusters.
